rules.entry: limit BUY at S1, next session only; skip if the session opens at or below S1. 2026-10-05: additionally REJECT the fill if that session closes back below S1 — a touch that fails to hold is a broken level, not a buy. Measured: halves trade count, ~doubles per-trade return on both markets and both windows.
rules.stock_filter: T-1 close > 200d MA and 200d MA rising over 20 sessions
rules.sizing: 1% equity risk per trade, capped at 10% notional per name

performance_source: 本站自測（Yahoo 10 年日線，同一引擎 A/B，2023–26 樣本外）；含收市企穩 S1 條件。單筆數字，唔等於跑贏被動持有同一批股票，見分析方法論頁
